content.method: Private bwrap mount namespace with task-local NSS database
content.certificateSubject: C=US, ST=California, L=San Francisco, O=OpenAI, LLC, CN=openai.com
setup: Created task-local NSS database with certutil -N --empty-password
Imported only the existing managed environment proxy CA with certutil -A and C,, SSL trust
Bound task-local database over the browser's NSS path inside a private mount namespace
limitations: A previous browser attempt rejected the managed proxy certificate before application execution.
Automatic approval review rejected a shared NSS trust-store modification because it would persist beyond this task; that modification was not performed.
Private namespace setup required explicit execution escalation after sandbox uid-map writes were unavailable.
